question: The sum of the first 20 terms of the series {1over5×6}+{1over6×7}+{1over7×8}+..... is:
solution:
**Given:**

Series: (1)/(5 times 6) + (1)/(6 times 7) + (1)/(7 times 8) + ldots

Number of terms (n) = 20

**Formula used:**

The general term of the series is (1)/(r(r+1))

It can be simplified as:

(1)/(r(r+1)) = (1)/(r) - (1)/(r+1)

**Calculations:**

The sum of the first 20 terms:

sumᵣ₌₅²⁴ ((1)/(r) - (1)/(r+1))

⇒ ((1)/(5) - (1)/(6)) + ((1)/(6) - (1)/(7)) + ldots + ((1)/(24) - (1)/(25))

All intermediate terms cancel out:

⇒ (1)/(5) - (1)/(25)

⇒ (5 - 1)/(5 times 25) = (4)/(25) = 0.16

**∴ The sum of the first 20 terms is 0.16.**
